scope: Actual storage module/engine/retry function with controlled IndexedDB opening/transaction callbacks, source bytes and decoder/file collaborators. No real IndexedDB atomicity, native/browser UI restart, quota exhaustion, audio playback or physical acceptance. Parent owns actual browser transaction and app restart tests.

checks.name: Blocked opening rejects and retry is not poisoned by late old success
Timed-out opening closes its late result while a retry remains usable
Version change closes owned connection and next operation reopens
Close during pending open rejects late success and closes its connection
Close aborts active transaction and settles pending operation
Actual engine lazily reads saved File once then uses decoded cache
Actual engine refuses failed restored reads without caching unusable media
Retry must not silently clear a failed catalog restore when no session tracks exist
checks.error: Retry clears startup failure without restoring catalog or saving a track
